name: dogfood-auth-passwordless-ux-app
description: Dogfood app v1.44-2 — a passwordless UX observability harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/auth v0.6 advanced device-bound-passkey + conditional-ui + cross-device-flow semantics + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 12-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the auth v0.6 semantics deterministically; makeRealAdapter emits a Chrome + Safari + Firefox WebAuthn L3 + iCloud Keychain + Chrome Sync API sequence when KIWA_MODE=real + KIWA_AUTH_PASSWORDLESS_URL are wired, otherwise reports KIWA_AUTH_PASSWORDLESS_ENV_MISSING.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/auth build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
